reviewer: Claude (the coding session), from the rendered videos and stills, two angles each; not the owner

push-press.note: with the corrective shapes the automated check passes (lats and teres major under 2%), and the dip, drive and press read right; but at lockout a flat sheet still flares out from each armpit, front and side: the deltoid band, which the shapes do not cover, stretched between the acromion and the raised humerus. Looked at side by side, before and after the shapes, the lockout looks the same. Still wrong by eye.

kettlebell-swing.note: a crease at the right shoulder at the top of the swing; hinge, bell path and hands on the handle read right

lateral-raise.note: raise to shoulder height, slight forward lean, dumbbells in the hands; front and rear renders

farmers-carry.note: walking stride with the dumbbells at the sides, arms straight

running-intervals.note: sprint stride, knee drive and arm swing read right

sled-push.note: hands on the posts, body angled into the sled, sled on the floor and moving

rowing-intervals.note: catch, drive and layback read as rowing; seat, handle and chain move with the body; the gracilis still stretches and pulls away from the thigh at the catch (the automated check fails it)

pallof-press.note: side-on to the cable, handle held at the chest with both hands and pressed out and back; the trunk holds; the press-out is short in the render; rear and front views

cable-woodchop.note: high-to-low chop with the trunk turning and the cable running to the top pulley; the coracobrachialis spike is gone; from behind, the far hand looks off the handle at mid-chop (the automated contact check covers the held hand)

medicine-ball-rotational-throw.note: ball held, trunk turns, ball leaves the hands at release; it reappears in the hands when the loop restarts (inherent to a looping throw)

air-bike-sprint.note: seated on the bike, hands on the levers, feet on the pedals; levers and cranks move with the body

dumbbell-curl.note: supinated curl, dumbbells in the hands to the shoulders, elbows at the sides; side and front renders

hammer-curl.note: neutral grip held through the curl

triceps-pushdown.note: straight bar at the cable, elbows at the sides, push to extension; cable runs to the top pulley; side and front renders

cable-chest-fly.note: between two towers, handles from the high pulleys, arms open wide and brought together low in front; cables stay in the hands; front and rear renders

inverted-row.note: body straight under the bar in the rack, heels on the floor, chest pulled to the bar; side and front renders

sumo-deadlift.note: wide stance, hands inside the knees, the bar pulled from the floor to lockout and back, reads as a sumo pull from both angles; the automated check fails it: the gracilis pulls away from the thigh, the bar sits 1.3 cm off the hands, and the baked playback strays 2.6 cm from the live solve between frames

overhead-triceps-extension.note: dumbbell held overhead in both hands, lowered behind the head and pressed back up; at the bottom the upper arms and armpits flatten into sheets and the elbows flare; the automated check fails it (teres major and lats stretched, teres minor and infraspinatus collapsed, wrists held at their limit, a 120° pop in a shoulder helper, the dumbbell 1.6 cm into the thumb)
